title: Simpson's paradox: drug and blood pressure
content: Drug B lowers blood pressure, which in turn affects heart-attack risk. Blood Pressure is a mediator rather than a confounder, so the total drug effect requires no adjustment for it.

variables.name: Blood Pressure
variables.content: The mediator affected by Drug B.
